content:
Ben (Recruiter): quick one — candidate Elena Gomez (Sr ML Eng) has a live counteroffer and is requesting a compensation tier uplift from T5 -> T6 plus an earlier start (2 weeks sooner) because of a visa window. Current approved package: base $155,000 + $15,000 sign-on + standard equity. Can we get a fast-path approval to close by EOD? cc @Leah

Leah (Hiring Manager): I can reallocate funds from the infra project budget temporarily. Will need formal written manager justification. If there's a provisional option that avoids full comp committee that would help.

Aisha (People Ops): Two practical routes here: 1) provisional uplift with a documented 6-month performance & comp review, or 2) full compensation committee approval (slower). For an EOD close we can do provisional if we get: manager justification, Priya sign-off on comp mechanics, finance ACK, and legal ok on contract language. Also need candidate sign-off that uplift is provisional and tied to the review.

Priya (Comp & Benefits): We can permit a provisional base uplift up to +10% over offered T5 base without full committee, and a one-time equity uplift (recommend ~25% increase to the grant) marked as one-off. Sign-on/relocation can be handled separately. Need the manager justification written here in the thread.

Ben (Recruiter): candidate is OK with a 6-month review clause if fair. They requested frontloading some of the relocation to cover earlier move costs — asking to frontload 50% of relocation on day 1. Is that feasible?

FinanceBot: Finance quick-check: infra project can cover up to $12,000 this quarter from contingency. If relocation + sign-on pushes above that we need finance manager escalation.

Aisha (People Ops): OK next steps to close today: 
- Leah: paste a 2–3 sentence manager justification here (why T6 is necessary now).
- Priya: reply with "approve provisional uplift" and list exact uplift numbers.
- FinanceBot (or finance lead): ACK the frontload amount.
- Sam (Legal): I'll loop you for the clause; we need a short amendment that says "provisional uplift subject to 6-month review; any permanent change requires comp committee sign-off".
- Ben: send revised offer with the language and get candidate sign-off.

Aisha (People Ops): Draft clause snippet for offer (use in the revised offer email/contract):

```
Provisional Compensation Adjustment: The base salary and/or equity included in this offer include a provisional adjustment granted by Redwood Inference for hiring and retention purposes. This provisional adjustment is conditional upon a performance and compensation review at approximately six (6) months from the candidate's start date. Any permanent change to base salary or equity resulting from that review will be subject to standard compensation governance processes. The candidate acknowledges and accepts this provisional nature by signing below.
```

Aisha (People Ops): For the relocation frontload, recommend phrase: "50% of the agreed relocation allowance will be paid within 5 business days of start; the remaining 50% is paid upon completion of 90 days of employment."

Leah (Hiring Manager): Manager justification: Elena has unique infra-to-model expertise and critical domain knowledge for the Q3 feature timeline. Losing her delays the project by ~6 weeks and increases contractor costs. Approving provisional uplift is warranted to avoid program slippage.

Priya (Comp & Benefits): approve provisional uplift: +8% base (from $155,000 -> $167,400) and one-time equity grant uplift of 25% to the current grant calculation. Sign-on unchanged. Relocation frontload approved up to $8,000 now (remainder on day 91).

FinanceBot: ACK — frontload $8,000 approved from infra contingency. Remaining relocation funds to be expensed to hiring cost center after 90 days.

Sam (Legal): I'll draft the amendment and attach it in ~30–45m. Flag: ensure candidate acceptance explicitly includes the review clause.

Ben (Recruiter): awesome — will send revised offer now with the clause and the relocation frontload. I’ll post candidate acceptance or any pushback in this thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Aisha (People Ops): I'll log this as a provisional comp exception and create the 6-month review reminder in our HR tracker. If anything changes, update the thread.
